command:

done
printf '%s\n' '--- target accounts ---'
getent passwd root opsadmin || true

command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then
  useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
fi
umask 077
printf '%s\n' root opsadmin > /tmp/cron.allow.antrieb
install -o root -g root -m 600 /tmp/cron.allow.antrieb /etc/cron.allow
rm -f /tmp/cron.allow.antrieb
restorecon /etc/cron.allow
printf '%s\n' 'installed cron allowlist and ensured opsadmin exists'

command:

done
